notes.title: Patch Notes 0.12.4
notes.content:
General

 Fixed the game having incorrect gamma (being too dark).

 Fixed unlockable storage “safe” not unlocking instantly after buying it.

 Fixed unlockable storages not unlocking when bringing them by the stash found during a run.

 Fixed an issue where large vertical spacing would make the LOD bug out. The search goes on!

 Fixed so that Mossman damage state isn’t a floaty texture anymore.

 Guild Approved Cuisine and Eating as Royals cookbook now unbugged.

 Poison Blood now works.

 Fixed the interact icon on the safe closest to Stiffleg.

 Water is now murky again!

 Electricity effect now doesn’t stay on forever if you died from a shock.

 Corrupted Amalgamation can now be permanently destroyed by explosives.

 Scroll of Least Resistance will now aim better on enemies

 Fixed crypt UI not going away.

 Fixed an infinite money glitch.

 Fixed insurance achievement not triggering immediately.

 Molotov now doesn’t have a wacky billboard facing flame.

 Fixed pickups sometimes being LODed out in siderooms

 Black Guild Bruiser and Craw Abomination now has properly aligned flesh.

Audio

 Fixed issue where Magazine Physics SFX didn't always trigger.

 Jar of Poison & Love Mixing (Now plays in 3D instead of 2D).

 Hellshrew Damage Impact Mixing.


Church

 The player can now correctly see the Fortress and Lucia’s Castle from the Church and the Car intro.

Town

 Fixed falling through the gaps in the planks on the wooden stairs leading down to the Cardinal mini-boss fight in Town.

 The two weapon chests after Cardinals are now one weapon chest and one armor chest instead.

 Water garbage in the waters in Shanty is now breakable.


Castle

 Fixed an exploit where you could jump out of the window during the Lucia fight to skip most of the fight.

Forest 

 Fix pink dev textures on the back of the forest crypt 

 Fixed an issue where players could get stuck between beams on a broken bridge in the forest.

Hedge Maze

 Added more Corrupted Amalgamations.

 Fixed Some fencing issues.

Bridge

 Fixed the collision of the ceilings in the guard houses.

 Fixed a collider of the trap door in the guard house which allowed enemies to shoot through it.

Fortress

 Fixed some rock placements in FortressGateCorridor1 which was resulting in some players getting stuck in a corner unable to escape.

 Added collision to a fence in FortressChunk1 that was previously missing.

Desert

 Fixed an issue with some desert side chunks intersecting with the main chunks in level generation.

 Fixed a generation issue which allowed players to leave the Desert map and fall into the void.

 Fixed the gap between the walls and ceiling in Crypt 04 (as well as fixing a couple of missing backfaces).

 Desert Clause now has human organs.

 Desert Clause hitbox should now be more reliable on bullet hit.

 Desert Clause now properly hides when underground.

 Can no longer walk away from Desert Clause without activating bossfight.

 Desert Clause Rocket Phase levels is reduced in size by 35%.

 Desert Clause moving sphere during the rocket phase is slightly faster.

notes.title: New Area: The Desert
notes.content:
SULFUR 0.12.0 – Desert Update
The Desert Update is here! This patch brings a brand new area, new enemies, weapons, a boss fight, and a ton of fixes and polish across the game.

[previewyoutube=ndxHbthgteA;full][/previewyoutube]

Major Content

 New Area: The Desert
 Crypt Challenges
 New Boss: Desert Claus
 4 New Enemy Types
 New Vendor: Bill
 10+ New Trinkets / Gadgets
 • Ass Wheel
 • Darklamp
 • Detective Pipe
 • Dog Whistle
 • Instant Defibrillator
 • Iron Feather
 • Library Card
 • Loaded Die
 • Lock of the Magus
 • Metabulator Pump
 • Range Finder
 • Yakety Sax
 3 New Weapons (shoutout Zatura!):
 • SMG “Valet”
 • DMR “Farsight”
 • Shotgun “Majordome”

Gameplay & Balance

 Holy Purge now correctly blinds the player.
 Storm Surge now damages the player for each hit.
 Thunderbolt now renders correctly with bounce oils.
 Oils with negative values no longer make weapons super valuable in stores.
 Enemies can no longer be stunned while blocking.
 Stun effect now interrupts enemy attack animations.
 Weapons no longer warp with FOV changes.
 Nerfed Lemonade’s run speed buff by 50%.
 Buffed the heal from Sausage Omelette, Rhubarb Porridge and Dopp i Grytan.
 Amalgamation sleep state increased to 10 seconds.
 Katana no longer valued at 1 SULF.
 PC: added extra secret rolling backup saves.
 Fixed recipes sometimes showing duplicate variants.

Controls

 Added rebinds for actions that use the D-pad on gamepads.
 Added rebinding for the alternative melee button on gamepads.
 Pressing B on a gamepad to back out of inventory, shop, or stash no longer causes a small unintended jump.
 Added rumble support on Parries & Alternative Attacks.

Weapon Fixes

 Killing with a melee weapon now grants XP to the last equipped weapon.
 Nunchaku hit radius shortened; swing animation variant now swings the other way.
 Bo Staff now aims correctly toward the hit marker.
 Wyatt and D4rt can no longer shoot when broken.
 Deathstar ammo count now shows correctly during reload.
 Pesticide range increased to match flamethrower.
 Folded weapons in UI now display as unfolded when equipped.
 Adjusted sight attachments for most guns: Balthazar, Arbiter2, Bronco, Beck8, Drifter9, FlickerZip, GraveKeeper, Dirk, Pale Horse Top Clipper, Salamander, Snut 38, Socom, Unknown, Wyatt Pulsar etc.

Enemies & Bosses

 Fixed Lucia’s invulnerability bug.
 Added navlinks so enemies can navigate up to the altar for the Lucia fight.
 Reworked boss loot a bit.
 Fixed issue where enemies were invulnerable in some cases.
 Fixed Cousin’s arms still attacking after death.
 Fixed Cousin’s elevator not coming down.
 Black Guild Rifleman blind spot removed (no more groin shots).
 Novanian guard chain ball no longer shreds instantly.
 Novanian guard flash effects adjusted (less blinding but still intense).
 Fixed some enemies not “death bouncing.”

Animation Improvements

 New Salamander animations.
 New Typhoon animations.
 New Flock animations.
 New Mario animations.
 New M11 animations.
 New M3 Termite animations.
 New Catacoil animations.
 New Dolphin animations.

Audio – Fixes & Improvements

 Reload sound redesign: Typhoon, 1884 Mario, Arbiter, Augusta.
 Reload sound fixes: Typhoon, Salamander, Balthazar.
 Added player footstep left/right alternation.
 Added back player take-damage sounds.
 Fixed player footstep speed triggers for sprint, crouch, ADS.
 Mixed Black Guild Bruiser baseball bat fidget distance.
 Optimized fire voice distance & attenuation.
 Optimized crows wingflap audio voices.
 General mixing, bugfixes, and performance improvements.
 New bullet passby sounds + optimized projectile passby system.
 Mixed units (chicken 🐔 et. al.).

Visuals & Performance

 Improved rendering performance on outdoor levels.
 FOV settings numbers adjusted (check your settings).
 Missing church windows restored.
 Improved weapon sway on Y axis when ADS.
 Fixed Gravekeeper’s “jumpy” ADS animation.
 Kombucha, Lemonade, and Bananabread now have unique artwork.

Level Fixes

 Increased ladder trigger size for easier climbing.
 Chests on Bridge are no longer empty.
 Fixed multichest bug in caves (hopefully the last one).
 Fixed an issue where a giant rock could block the player in Fortress Pools.

Achievements

 Fixed “Explosive Personality” achievement.
 Fixed “Amulet Free” achievement.

notes.title: Shav'Wa Showdown
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=D6DMCcuVxB0;full][/previewyoutube]

FORTRESS UPDATE - SHAV’WA SHOWDOWN (0.11.0)
June 26, 2025

What’s New?

New Area: The Fortress 
Subarea: The Pools Bathhouse 
New Boss: The Shav'Wa Emperor - Good luck.
New Feature: Gun Insurance - Attach it to your weapon and if you die, the gun makes it back to the hub. You don’t. The Insurance will be consumed on death, and you will have to get new coverage (insurance brokers have a special place in hell, and they are still profiting). 
Some (10) Steam Achievements, more coming later, working on it!
New Enchantments:
 • Scroll of Corpse Explosion  
 • Scroll of Petrify  
 • Scroll of Thunderbolt  
 • Scroll of Least Resistance
Recipe cookbooks added for: 
 • Town, Sewers, Dungeon, Castle, Forest, Fortress 

Gameplay Improvements & Fixes

Player hitbox is now more accurate (and slightly smaller). Crouch to dodge arrows like a pro.
Scopes now pierce the fog a little more so you can see what’s coming.
Sentinels no longer wiggle or jump while frozen.
Sentinels no longer jump through roofs if there are roofs.
Silencers now reduce aggro chance instead of instantly alerting enemies.
Grenades won’t cause full-map aggro anymore.
If you're knocked out of bounds in boss fights, you’ll now be properly respawned inside the arena.
Jumping off ladders feels less like being a spider's prey.
Molotov equip sound no longer melts ears.
Sprint toggle on controller behaves correctly now (hold-to-sprint mode improved).
Bouncing bullets now bounce slightly randomly, just how you like it.
Item spawns have been toned down to avoid loot falling into the abyss.
Lucia’s eye gibs now show when shot, and her animations won’t break anymore.
Salt + fish now makes salted fish
Shapeshifter mutation now includes all Craw, Black Guild, and Shav’Wa variants.
Rarity drop effects behave properly now.
Falling items now get deleted properly.
Double ammo counters bug when changing levels has been fixed.
Novanian Guard midboss now actually fights you properly again.
Cardinals can’t be cheesed through curtains anymore.
“Lorem ipsum” placeholder dialog removed from Haukland.
Bishops stay still when firing or charging now.
Star & Witness reload animation glitch resolved.
Return-to-church hardlock fixed.
Enemy pathing improved to reduce clustering.
Cooking now works even if ingredients are already in the cauldron.
HP preview no longer gets stuck when closing inventory with a hovered consumable on gamepad.
Chickens now explode correctly when killed, as they should.

Weapons & Visuals

Gun animations updated: Ferryman, Mossman, Duhar, and Deathstar.
Adjusted zoom levels across 20+ scoped weapons for consistency:
Beck8, Dirk, Bronco, Gravekeeper, Snut38, Balthazar, Socom, FlickerZip, CorpseMaker, Vrede, Knop, NeuraxisF22, Tailor Marksman, Unknown, Duhar, Rokua, Deathstar, Ferryman
High FOV adjustments: Shoulder animations no longer break when sprinting.
Flamethrower buff: Flames now linger twice as long.
Pesticide: Poison duration increased.
CorpseMaker weapon animation state bug resolved.

Enchantments Fixes

Chain Lightning now procs correctly.
Chaos Strike no longer leaves behind permanent debuffs.
Grub Grub now always opens the door when killed (as intended).

See you in the Fortress.
🎮 Discord | 💌 Email List

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.10.12
notes.content:
Thank you for all the feedback over the weekend!
We have been reworking a lot of the central systems in the game this last few weeks which is making the game way more performant, but this also means the introduction of quite a few new bugs, but in the long term it's good for the game.
A lot of the game breaking bugs has been fixed today.

It's also worth mentioning that some bugs are helped by running the "Validate game files" function in in steam.
And as always, if you find any bugs it helps us a great deal if you report them in our discord ( ourdiscord.com ).
Player logs are found in [code]%appdata%\..\LocalLow\Perfect Random\Sulfur[/code]

Patch notes 0.10.12


 Bronco can now reload properly even if reload speed oil has been added
 Adjusted loot drop force.
 If aim is held (or toggled) when a weapon is reloaded, it will continue aiming after reload finishes. Useful for knop mains
 Novanian Guard now doesn’t spam attacks for no reason.
 Lingering Terrorbaum targets after fight now disappears properly
 Fixed Jaques De Fector dialog showing incorrect text.
 Fixed z-fighting on Town Civilian Woman.
 Fixed crash on loading.
 Fixed double weapon UI on death
 Fixed Novanian guard boss not moving.
 Fixed scopes getting rotated wrong over time.
 Fixed an issue that made the player get stuck in the crafting UI.
 Fixed not receiving crafted items if they couldn’t fit in the inventory. They now spawn in the world around the crafting station if they won’t fit.
 Fixed Black Guild Bishops sliding during shoot animation
 Fixed dead ghosts not disappearing.
 Fixed chests spawning inside other chests.
 Fixed some consumables not applying hp regen correctly

notes.title: QoL of Life Update - 0.10.9
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=5vTwGxLqy4s;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re packing in a bunch of quality-of-life features and a cascade of small improvements that should make SULFUR smoother, faster, and more satisfying for y'all to enjoy! 

Quality of Life Improvements

 Cooking assistance: Easy-to-follow recipes for everything you’ve cooked before.
 Biggest performance and optimizations update yet!
 Interaction type icons now appear in dialogues, helping the lazy eye navigate quickly.
 New accessibility options: Toggle sprint, toggle aim, etc.
 Cleanup and improved weapon animations
 Toggle sprint and toggle aim options added.
 Player damage disabled in safe zones for less tragic deaths.
 The Church Collection Box now lights up when it has money in it.
New Content
 New Weapon: Neuraxis F22
 New Explosive: Proximity Mine 
 New Cookbooks: Unlock new recipes and remember the ones you’ve already discovered!
 New Enemy: Corrupted Lurk — Watch your step in the Sewers (we heard y'all were stepping a bit too easy).

More Changelog Highlights

 Railgun enchantments now apply correct damage and visuals.
 Knop received a full animation overhaul.
 Enemy footsteps are now louder and include landing sounds.
 Ugly candles should not be ugly anymore.
 New enchantment audio and fancy donation box particles.
 Novanian Guards now spawn in the Castle.
 Big enemies no longer squeeze into tiny spaces.
 Leaving water is now smoother and more reliable.
 AI improvements for better & dumber gameplay!
 Oils affecting reload speed have been tweaked to work better.
 Various bug fixes: Penetration Oil restored, Task Oil works properly, no more Z-fighting grass tufts, bounces apply correct values, and more!
 If you shoot a brick it now behaves like more brickly
 Falling out of the third story sequence no longer will soft-lock player in eternal hell. 

Known Bugs:

 Breached won't reset ammo in mag, press F and you can shoot again, it's a bit jank but will be hotfixed ASAP. 

Coming: The Fortress
The next big update will introduce The Fortress. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Performance Update - Patch Notes 0.9.15
notes.content:
Performance Update - Patch Notes 0.9.15

We’ve been hard at work optimizing the game to ensure a smoother and better experience for everyone. While there’s still room for improvement, this patch brings significant upgrades that should make SULFUR feel better than ever. 🖥️✨

✨ Improvements: ✨
🏃 Performance overhaul! The game runs smoother on all machines, no matter how ancient or shiny. 
🎨 Replaced all PNG sprites with SVGs, switching out pixels for vector art—think of it as upgrading from a 20-year-old Renault to a 10-year-old Volvo. Reliable, efficient, and just better.  🚗 🇸🇪
🖼️ Effects, environments, and levels have been reworked to be far less taxing on your hardware.
⏳ Loading times are noticeably faster. 
🔥 Melee enemies now also have the ability to use elemental effects! 
🔫 Bullet holes are now limitless and will never tank performance, and enemies stay above ground so you can spray away with confidence!
🌩️ Aftershock has been nerfed and now has a 10% chance of triggering instead of 100%.

☝️Note: Later areas like the Dungeon still need a bit more work, but the framerate is definitely more stable with fewer hiccups. (We know what more to do, but we just don’t have time right now because it’s Christmas, Swedish tradition demands us to watch Donald Duck cartoons and eat Janssons Frestelse, and we’re already neglecting our children/families enough as it is. 🎄🎅)

🐛 Bug Fixes:
🐶 Dogs can no longer be cheesed by doing that little backstep. 
🗺️ Fixed an issue where item names didn’t properly localize in break notifications. 💬🌍
🦾 Stiffleg now correctly misses the right arm—not the wrong one. We’ve triple-checked. I think.
🌋 Fixed elemental damage from poison, frost, and lava unfairly stacking against you.  ❄️☠️🔥

Additions:
🚀 The rocket enchantment is back! Use responsibly.
🐬 The Dolphin has been buffed—now deadlier, snappier, and hopefully more ready to make waves among y’all.
👣 New Enemy Mutation: Elemental trails 

💡 We’re still working out a few quirks, but this update should make SULFUR run smoother and your computer happier. Let us know how it feels!

🌲 Future Updates 🌲
We’re nearing the end of the Fixing Shit phase and are excited to shift our focus to what’s next: adding more content full-time! 🎉 Here’s what you can expect as we dive into the next phase:


 Next Area 🌲 The Forest  will be the next area to expand your journey, complete with new enemies and challenges.
 More Guns & Magic: 🪄🔫  We’re hard at work creating new weapons and magical abilities to keep things fresh and deadly.
 And Future Areas in Progress  🏜️ 🏰  While working on The Forest, we’re already planning ahead for the Fortress, Desert, and beyond.

notes.title: SULFUR OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Mothersulfers,

We are happy to announce that SULFUR Early Access is now available.

What is SULFUR?
For those who haven’t already spent hundreds of hours diving into the SULFUR demo, let us catch you up on what SULFUR is all about.

SULFUR is a modern-yet-retro looter shooter about food, music, and good vibes. It is allegedly an “extraction shooter” (whatever that means), where you play as a priest on a bloody revenge quest, hoovering up every bit of loot dropped by the poor enemies who stand in your way.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43531514/3b9aafb13c522f1fcb0f88b586744a4f0e8604b7.jpg

SULFUR combines loopy roguelite gameplay with a classic late-90s FPS campaign format. Like in any good roguelite, dying means losing everything, but in SULFUR, story progression and levels unlocked are still kept even if you mess up a run.

You either die and lose all of your precious loot, or you manage to extract and make it back home to your church, The Original Sin. Here you can stash your ill-gotten gains, catch up on the latest happenings and trade with your congregation before gearing up for your next run.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43531514/66539594f6689cbc0a1302c0e310f54b5d9df1ad.jpg

New Early Access Content
SULFUR launches with six areas to explore, each with its own look, enemies and item drops. Hundreds of items that were not available in the demo are there for you to find, including new guns, enchantments, equipment, and most importantly: new tasty foods and ways to cook them!

We have already shared an Early Access Roadmap, but here is a little refresher on our plans:

The Early Access Roadmap
Right from the start, our primary focus is on playtesting, listening to feedback, and addressing any bugs or issues that might have slipped past our own testing.
After this initial phase, we’ll dive into creating new biomes along with their respective content, building up to the ultimate boss fight, and last but not least comes Endless Mode - a feature unlocked by conquering the main game. 

Endless Mode takes you into a wildly unpredictable experience, where no two runs are the same, and you face random enemies in much more randomized environments.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43531514/d169f9b41aad430100f145c4ee7c390b3966917d.png

The Future of SULFUR - Stretch Goals

If we sell over 200k SULFURs, we will have the means to finally tackle the most requested feature since forever: Multiplayer. 

Our vision for Multiplayer is a classic “drop in, drop out” experience, letting you seamlessly join a friend’s game and head out on runs together. It’ll feel just like single-player, with shared progression and item drops, so you and your buddy can build your arsenals and tackle the challenges of SULFUR side-by-side.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43531514/af2dc6284bb9581a4e80e58f2b381eae83496d7f.jpg

Join Us On Discord
For those who want an even closer look into SULFUR’s development, look no further than our Discord server, where we regularly talk about what’s going on in our minds and with the game.

-The SULFUR team

Link to Patch Notes

notes.title: 🎮 How We Make SULFUR Feel at Home on Steam Deck
notes.content:
🕹️ SULFUR on Steam Deck: What We Adapted and Why
As we approach the release of SULFUR, we’ve put in some extra work to make sure it feels right on the Steam Deck. Valve’s handheld has quickly become a go-to for indie games, and we wanted to make sure our game plays great on the go without losing any of the challenge. Here’s a look at the things we have done to tailor SULFUR for the Steam Deck. 

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44304643/e17fcffc311c0f61b8465a4351e68c62be34009c.jpg
Showcasing SULFUR on Steamdeck at PAX West 2024

🎛️ Control Remapping & Analogue Gamefeel
We made some changes to the controls to fit the Steam Deck’s layout, ensuring button prompts are clear and representative. We also included non-linear analogue stick input for better control and allowed for full button remapping. Whether docked or handheld, the controls are easy to tweak so they feel right for you.

🏃 Making Platforming More Forgiving
To keep platforming smooth in handheld mode, we added a bit of extra coyote time. This small change gives players a grace period after running off a ledge to still make a jump, making gameplay feel more forgiving without losing the challenge.

🖥️ UI Adjustments for Handheld Play
When we updated the UI for the Steam Deck, we had taken inspiration from games like Diablo, Escape from Tarkov, and thankfully Resident Evil 4. Our goal was to make sure everything was easy to navigate and read on a smaller screen, while still staying true how SULFUR is played on PC. We also decided against using the touch screen for UI interactions because, honestly, clean screens matter. Everything is built around smooth button navigation instead.

📺 Performance Tweaks for Smooth Play
Steam Deck’s 1280x800 resolution gave us some work to do, but we’ve adjusted SULFUR to look good and run smoothly on the device. One big improvement we made was switching out all sprites for SVGs (vector art), which are far less taxing on the system. This change not only helps the game run smoother but also significantly improves battery life.

🎯 Using Gyro Aiming for Precision
For those who like more precision, we added a custom controller with gyro functionality for aiming down sights (ADS). You can tilt the Steam Deck to fine-tune your aim, which adds a nice layer of control when you’re in the middle of a fight.

🔧 Conclusion: Steam Deck Is a Great Platform for FPS too
We’re really excited about what the Steam Deck brings to both players and developers. For us, adapting SULFUR wasn’t just about making the game work—it was about making it feel right. The Steam Deck offers indie devs a unique way to connect with players who otherwise might stick to console, and as we keep improving the game and adding content through early access, the Deck remains a perfect platform for pushing boundaries for indie-FPS on gamepad. And hopefully we're giving players new ways to engage with the challenge and depth that SULFUR offers!

✅ Note - Left to fix:

 [strike]Stashing ammo & money with controller: This feature is currently being added to the game’s control functionality to allow for smooth inventory management with a gamepad, making it easier for players to stash items while using a controller or Steam Deck.[/strike]

 UI cooking bug: There is a known issue where items are accidentally added to the cauldron during cooking. This bug is being resolved as quickly as possible to prevent unintended item placement while players are managing their cooking inventory.

 [strike]Shooting while running: Shooting while running should be possible, but it will interrupt the run. The planned solution is to automatically un-toggle the run when aiming, allowing players to shoot without fully stopping their movement.[/strike]


https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44304643/6917681215b23b43f4d3fd21e58ec6724bc99246.png

Coming to Steam October 28th 🔥 

We are excited to announce that SULFUR will officially be entering Early Access on October 28th! We cannot wait for you to dive deeper into the game and experience everything we’ve been working on. The Early Access version will bring even more intense action, new areas, enemies, and challenges to conquer. 

DEMO Updated for Steam Next Fest 
As we approach the Early Access release of SULFUR, our focus has shifted primarily to content beyond what’s available in the demo. However, we've also made significant improvements to the overall game, and these enhancements have been incorporated into the demo as well.

Patch Notes: 0.8.0 DEMO
 Loot Rebalancing
 Level Generation Optimization
 Graphical Optimization
 Enemy Balancing
 Better Hit Detection
 Audio Improvements
 Controller Remapping
 Expanded Graphics Options
 A plethora of smaller fixes and additions

Graphics Optimization
Switching most 2D assets from the .png format to .svg has significantly boosted SULFUR's performance on most systems.

Rebalanced loot
Loot has been rebalanced across the board, affecting both enemy drops and chests. Some chests, such as Wooden/Low Tier chests, have been completely revamped and now have a chance to drop any item in the game (limited to demo items in the demo version).

Improved system for level gen
Additionally, we’ve rewritten the level generation system, resulting in drastically reduced loading times. It will be even better during early access.

Improved hit detection
Changes to how bullets function have improved hit detection, particularly when your gun fires multiple projectiles.

Controller Remapping
We’ve also expanded the options menu to support controller remapping for both keyboard & mouse and game controllers.

notes.title: Demo Update - Celebrating the Rhubarb!
notes.content:
Hi Demo Sulfers!

This is a special week in this part of human Earth where we celebrate Pentecost Week! 

We are being lifted from the cold, arctic darkness, now the snow is melting away, putrid stench of decaying earth hangs heavily in the air, and the first living thing is coming out the soil. The since-long-dead animals and plants are being consumed by something living green, and is the nothing but the Rhubarb! Magnificent! Its big leaves are poisonous, but the sour, tangy and stringy stems are edible, fresh, and full of vitamin C. This calls for a SULFUR Update!

The only canonical downside of Pentecost week is that the cost of pants go up, luckily there are no pants in Sulfur. *badumdish*

New tasty treats with Rhubarb

 Rhubarb sauce
 Rhubarb porridge
 Rhubarb pie

Rhubarb Sauce Recipe

 4 cups thinly sliced rhubarb 
 ½ cup white sugar 

Steps 
[olist]
 Stir in rhubarb and sugar; 
 Continue to cook, stirring constantly, until tender, 5 to 10 minutes. 
 Hail the Rhubarb. Serve warm.
[/olist]
Patch notes

Bugfixes

 Fixed units dying from being frozen not dropping any loot.
 Fixed dead units blocking the paths of living units.
 Fixed units sometimes getting stuck in an idle animation after death.
 Fixed issue where the levelgeneration sometimes spawned in the wrong units or too many units.
 Fixed units being pushable in situations where they shouldn't be.
 Fixed issue where the camera would end up outside the level in some positions.
 A bunch of smaller fixes and polishes.

Balancing

 A lot of consumables have had their numbers adjusted.
 Goblin Wizards has been buffed with a higher attack rate.
 Adjusted weapon values/costs.

Additions

 Consumables can now be put in the quick slots.
 New recipes, both for totally new foods and some new recipes for old ones.


We wanna thank all players for being so awesome and supporting our development! We also want you to  join the community  on our discord  and sign up for the closed beta thru the official SULFUR website.

Happy Rhubarb and Merry Pentecost from all of us to all of you!
Perfect Random Team
